# oneprovider_server (Data Source)

OneProvider server data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get information about a specific server
data "oneprovider_server" "example" {
  id = "12345"
}

output "server_ip" {
  value = data.oneprovider_server.example.ip_addr
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Server ID to look up

### Read-Only

- `billing_cycle` (String) Billing cycle
- `hostname` (String) Server hostname
- `ip_addr` (String) Server IP address
- `location` (String) Server location
- `recurring_amount` (String) Recurring amount
- `status` (String) Server status
- `username` (String) Server username
